content: Brazilian crypto tax preço médio rules: (1) Preço médio = (total cost of all purchases including fees) / total quantity. (2) On PARTIAL SALE: the unit average cost (preço médio) does NOT change. Total acquisition cost reduces proportionally: new_total_cost = old_total_cost * (remaining_qty / old_qty). Equivalently: new_total_cost = preço_médio * remaining_qty. (3) Capital gain on sale = sale_proceeds - (preço_médio * qty_sold). (4) R5k monthly exemption: if total disposals in a month are under R5k, gains are exempt (report under Rendimentos Isentos). Over R5k: taxable at 15-22.5%.
